title: ID0417497-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001028] - PowerConverter E17 toggling
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
PowerConverter E17 during session makes the kW limited
Solution:
Replace converter
Truck charging customer that the chargers charges at full power but then after 10 minutes suddenly stops.
R&D ticket created EVC3-9162

additional_info.subject: ID0417497-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001028] - PowerConverter E17 toggling CRM:00315002528
additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Vantaa
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
ZligFW
Problem Description
: Charging is limited when PowerConverter occurs and recovers
Troubleshooting
:
As we already had a site visit, here is the summary of the actions:
When EV was charging in DC2, suddenly we had E17 in one of the PowerConverters. As such, the session was reduced by 20kW.
Problem came when the converter suddenly recovered from the E17 and locked in 150V instead of 800V necessary for the EV. In this case the charging was limited to 0kW because the whole DC2 group was not running due to the voltage difference.
When charging in a different outlet, the error is the same but since it's a different group we get limited by the DC2 and subsquent group (DC4).
After replacing the converter the charger is working again properly.
As I mentioned I already created a R&D ticket since this seems to be a bug.
I will close the ticket tomorrow if it doesn't reappear.
For future reference, your case number is
0417497
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
